summary: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corp, a BVI-domiciled NYSE-listed blank-check company, disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K that on September 17, 2026, sponsor SB Capital Holding Corporation underwent a full ownership change: Poseidon Ocean Corporation transferred 3,813,333 sponsor shares and four individuals transferred 5,000 each, aggregating 3,833,333 shares representing 100% of the sponsor's equity, to Chi-Ping Cindy Lee. The sponsor remains sponsor and record holder of the same company securities, with IPO-related rights and obligations unchanged. No price, premium, or board recommendation stated. Watch for governance or deal-direction shifts given the new sole sponsor owner.
